Hero.title: Concerts with Mom and Dad
Hero.subtitle: Interactive musical activity for children aged 0 to 5 years
Hero.description: Based on the teaching experience that the group members have carried out for over 15 years at nurseries and kindergartens in Rome and its province. Annamaria Diroma, Francesca Scaglione and Monserrat Olavarria Balmaceda lead the activity through voice and instruments, proposing rhythms and melodies drawn from the most varied musical repertoire. The intervention method is designed and thought out based on the real listening abilities of children and is inspired by the principles of musical learning by E.E. Gordon. During the activity children are free to interact with music through voice and movement.

article.title: Music at nursery school develops language
article.description: Musical stimulation in children from zero to three years promotes the growth of innate abilities that would otherwise be lost within a few years. The neuroscientist: "It is among the most effective psychomotor activities for verbal and short-term memory and spatial-temporal ability"
